t: # Short Obligatory Prayer ## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon. Miiye odase, Oo mi-Nyɔŋmɔ, akɛ Obɔ mi ni male Bo ni madza O. Miyeɔ he odase ŋmɛlɛtswaa nɛɛ. Miiye migbɔdzɔmɔ lɛ kɛ Ohewalɛ lɛ, mihia kɛ Oninamɔ lɛ he odase. Nyɔŋmɔ kroko ko bɛ Osɛɛ Dza Bo. Bualɔ yɛ fimɔ beiaŋ kɛ mɔ ni yɛ ha Lɛ-diɛntsɛ ehe.
